title: Li$^{2}$SAO: Lifting Light Singl-Rollout Asynchronous RL Optimization via Group-Relative Actor-Critic Bootstrapping
abstract: arXiv:2610.40726v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) is becoming a mainstream paradigm for post-training large language models (LLMs), as it improves training efficiency by updating the model as rollouts arrive. Recent work argues that group-wise sampling in GRPO does not naturally fit asynchronous RL training because rollout lengths follow a long-tailed distribution, and proposes Single-rollout Asynchronous Optimization (SAO) to improve stability and off-policy behavior, especially on agentic tasks. However, SAO relies on a closed-source value model obtained from scaling value pretraining. In this paper, we analyze GRPO and LiSAO, our lightweight reproduction of SAO without the pretrained value model, on single-turn reasoning and multi-turn agentic tasks. We find that GRPO outperforms LiSAO on reasoning tasks, while the reverse holds on agentic tasks. Since the value model of LiSAO is not yet well trained , LiSAO lags behind GRPO substantially in e

translated_title: Li²SAO：通过组相对Actor-Critic自举提升轻量级单rollout异步强化学习优化
translated_abstract: 异步强化学习（RL）正日益成为大语言模型（LLM）后训练的主流范式，因为它可以在rollout到达时即更新模型，从而提升训练效率。近期研究指出，GRPO中的组级采样并不天然契合异步RL训练，因为rollout长度服从长尾分布，并据此提出了单rollout异步优化（SAO），以提升稳定性和离策略表现，尤其是在智能体任务上。然而，SAO依赖于一个通过大规模价值预训练获得的闭源价值模型。本文在单轮推理任务和多轮智能体任务上分析了GRPO与LiSAO——即我们对SAO的轻量级复现（不含预训练价值模型）。我们发现，GRPO在推理任务上优于LiSAO，而在智能体任务上则情况相反。由于LiSAO的价值模型尚未得到充分训练，LiSAO在此方面大幅落后于GRPO……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出Li²SAO，通过组相对Actor-Critic自举摆脱对大规模预训练价值模型的依赖，在轻量级单rollout异步RL优化中兼顾推理任务与智能体任务的表现。
